208025.description:
Amona’s a dark summoner with demonic powers. Roni’s a devout priest who’s way too uptight. By all rights, they should hate each other. Instead, they end up fast-tracking their enemies-to-lovers arc with a one-night stand that somehow insists on becoming a recurring event. Now they must hide their situationship from the rest of the party while denying their growing attraction to one another, all while dealing with an imp who’s far too invested in their love life.

(Source: HIDIVE)

208044.description:
The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he’s reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

208055.description:
The story takes place in a world where human civilization has collapsed and fallen into ruin.
In this world, there are people who live in groups and people who live individually, moving around. – a world of freedom, so to speak.
Two girls, Haru and Tamo, who live in such a world, board an old train they come across by chance and travel through the decadent world day by day.

(Source: Niigata International Animation Film Festival)

Notes:
- Initially pre-screened at the Niigata International Animation Film Festival on March 15, 2025, as well as at the Fantasia Film Festival on July 19, 2025.
- Selected for the Fantasia Film Festival Anime no Bento official selection highlighting indie talent, as well as winning the audience award and gold award in the Animated Short category at the Fantasia Film Festival 2025.

208064.description:
A chance encounter between young Tang Zhi and a dragon maiden unexpectedly awakened his "Heavenly Eye"—allowing him to see gods and spirits roaming the mortal realm. These unique eyes led him into a world that coexisted with the mundane. Through unforgettable experiences, Tang Zhi made friends with all sorts of people and experienced laughter and warmth in seemingly ordinary yet subtly wondrous daily moments. An ordinary scholar, encountering and accompanying a group of gods and spirits with diverse personalities amidst the everyday life of the mortal world—this story of adventure, friendship, and growth is slowly unfolding.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

208065.description:
Lele, a white dog, and Xiaoliang, a gray one-eyed cat, run a struggling convenience store. Besides selling goods, they also take on commissions to earn money. The story follows Lele and Xiaoliang as they complete various tasks, experiencing a series of small adventures together—stories about courage, understanding, and learning how to love and be loved.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

208066.description:
At the Hudsucker corporate headquarters, a salaryman (“Me”) is the constant target of his hulking, bald, perverted boss’ violent retribution. Bittersweet childhood memories of Me’s late grandmother keep him going, but his brutal work life pushes him to the breaking point. Me gets sweet revenge and hightails it out of Tokyo, only to have his airplane violently hijacked. He’s dumped into the Pacific Ocean and onto the shores of remote island Mahoroba (an ancient Japanese word describing a far-off utopia).

Note: Screened at the 13th Shimokitazawa Film Festival on September 20, 2021, where it also won the Grand Prize among 12 nominated works.

208067.description:
Midnight. A construction site. A man with a colored corn head and a woman with pink hair meet in a powerful encounter. A provocative tale of love, right and wrong over a quarter of a century between two outcasts. A sensational subject matter and a staggered ethical viewpoints are explored in this latest work of the artist’s best work! We run, leaving the world behind.

Note: Won the Japanese Grand Prize at the 9th New Chitose Airport International Animation Festival in 2022.

208225.description:
Elsa, the daughter of a fallen aristocrat, receives news. It was a marriage proposal from Julius, a very elite nobleman. Elsa is wondering," Why would such a distinguished man marry me"? 208264.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by Shiganai Atelier (シガナイアトリエ).

The four suns that bestow blessings upon the world. When one of them vanished, the people mourned deeply. Naia, an aerial explorer who ventures across the skies, and Mano, an automaton, set out to investigate the Tower in the Mist—the place where the sun was said to have fallen—but they were caught in a storm, and their airship malfunctioned. While repairing it inside the tower, they decided to search for the sun. “Well then, I’m off to investigate right away!” However, the interior of the tower was an eerie space—a complex labyrinth teeming with countless monsters. To make matters worse, a ghost appeared, and Naia was captured. The ghost was controlled by Mary, a girl with a mysterious past. Though she seems somewhat carefree, she appears to show absolutely no mercy to intruders in the tower… A tanned, energetic girl raised in the tropics and a fair-skinned, soft-skinned automaton (mechanical doll). The erotic adventure drama woven by this black-and-white, mismatched duo is about to begin!!

(Source: Getchu, translated)

208352.description:
Dandelion follows Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane, members of the Japanese Angel Federation’s Send-Off Department. Their job? Tracking down restless earthbound spirits and gently guiding them to the afterlife.

While other angels rush to close their cases, the 21st Division’s Dandelion Clan takes a different approach. Dandelion members Tetsuo Tanba and his leader, Misaki Kurogane, listen to each spirit’s regrets and help them resolve what’s holding them back. They even help a spirit who’s an elderly man running at full speed, desperate to escape.

The angels themselves are full of surprises. Tanba’s permanent scowl and sharp tongue mask a deeply compassionate nature, while Kurogane is a formidable force — despite her girlish appearance. She’s rumored to have laid to rest the legendary soul of Musashi Miyamoto.

(Source: Netflix)

208609.description:
In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out.

After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks…

(Source: J-Novel Club)

208754.description:
The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality.

Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman.

Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

Note: Released as part of the Echoes of Aincrad: Sword Art Online's game limited edition.

208766.description:
They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

The Nohara family then go to the land of youkai and find themselves in a mysterious yet nostalgic world, where they go on an unpredictable adventure.
